title: Cohort-aware probe scheduler and staged rollback policy
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Summary: Implement a cohort-aware probe scheduler that issues eval probes from stratified golden sets across customer cohorts, dynamically adjusts sampling rates based on recent signal, and enables staged rollback/quarantine per cohort. Goals: 1) Detect quality regressions earlier for high-risk cohorts without increasing overall probe budget; 2) Allow targeted partial rollback/quarantine (e.g., per-customer or per-geography) with hysteresis to avoid flapping; 3) Provide observability hooks (per-cohort scorecard, probe provenance, and audit trail) for SRE/PM; 4) Integrate with shadow and split traffic to calibrate thresholds. Scope: scheduling algorithm + runtime admission API + controller to manage quarantine/rollback decisions + dashboard panels and a small policy DSL for thresholding. Out of scope: large-scale UI redesign and policy language v2. Design constraints: operate within current probe budget (no >20% increase in global probes), respect PII rules (no storing raw customer prompts outside golden reservoir), and be compatible with Dedicated/Private routing constraints. Acceptance criteria: - End-to-end flow from probe scheduling to cohort-scoped rollback orchestrator implemented in staging; - Per-cohort scorecard with time-series and delta metrics available in Console; - Automated rollback trigger for cohorts when score drops below configured threshold for N probes with cooldown; - No more than 10% added median tail latency on probe pipeline; - Unit + integration tests and docs published. Risks: noisy cohorts with low traffic can cause unstable thresholds; golden-set overlap across cohorts needs fingerprinting; rollback actions must not cause customer-visible partial failures. Mitigations: stratified sampling, prompt fingerprinting, hysteresis windows, and manual review gates for high-impact cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: Staging: probe scheduler emits cohort-stratified probes and Console shows per-cohort scorecards
Automated rollback: orchestrator can quarantine single cohorts and revert back after healthy window
Probe budget: global probe volume increases <= 20% and per-customer probes limited by config
Observability: probe provenance and audit logs available for every automated action
Tests and docs: unit tests, integration tests, feature doc and runbook in Confluence
